summary: Phase 8 FINAL UAT resume run — completed all pending items from iteration_21 with proper pacing and per-role batching (no rate-limit hits this round). VERIFIED GREEN (live): (1) Service worker now registers on the preview — navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration() returns an active registration with scope '/' and navigator.serviceWorker.controller is set; /sw.js still serves 200; no SW console errors during load. (2) Bottom-nav data-testids resolve to exactly 1 element at 390px — buyer-bottomnav=1 (as demo.buyer) and ops-bottomnav=1 (as demo.procops). (3) Retired-route redirects with correct roles: as demo.procops, /ops/sourcing→/ops/procurement and /ops/quality→/ops/exceptions; ops sidebar has NO 'Quality' entry (shows Exceptions/Procurement/Orders/Logistics/Claims only). As a partner (see credentials note below), /partner/qc→/partner/logistics, partner sidebar has NO 'QC' entry (shows Home/Jobs/Delivered only). (4) Role isolation friendly-denial screens across all three combos requested — demo.buyer→/admin/overview and /ops/exceptions both render the human 'You don't have access to …' card with a Return-to-my-workspace link (not raw JSON/403 page); demo.procops→/admin/overview same friendly deny card; partner→/buyer/home same friendly deny card. (5) Supplier Capabilities as demo.supplier — product select populates variety select on change (e.g. Anthurium → 'Red Success · RED'), Add creates a new capability that appears in the list with a human status pill ('Active'), and there is NO raw UUID input anywhere on the page (only selects + non-UUID free text search input). (6) Admin Catalog Version history as demo.admin — picking 'Grade profiles' and clicking Load renders rows as human one-line summaries ('A · v1 · active · from 16/9/2026') with no raw JSON braces anywhere in the rendered rows. (7) Buyer catalog Validated label — Dendrobium Orchid card shows the 'Validated' badge (not 'Demo — not for production buying'). (8) Keyboard-only a11y — login tab order is email → password → submit (activeElement.type transitions email→password→(BUTTON 'Sign in')); visible focus ring is a 2px solid green outline (rgb(24,61,51)); buyer home reaches interactive controls with Tab; SideSheet on /ops/exceptions (ops-board-sheet) opens on board-item click, focus moves inside the dialog, Escape closes it and dialog count returns to 0; bottom nav at 390px is reachable by Tab (focus reached data-testid=ops-nav-exceptions-bottom after ~21 tabs). (9) Upload rejection UX — as demo.buyer on /buyer/org KYB form, injecting an 'evil.txt' File via DataTransfer and submitting produced a clear human error banner: 'Unsupported or mismatched media type. Allowed: JPEG, PNG, WebP, PDF, MP4'. No stack trace, no success. (10) Empty-state / skeleton spot checks — demo.finance /ops/finance renders 'Nothing awaiting finance action' empty card; demo.support /ops/claims renders 'No claims in this view — Claims raised by buyers will appear here for support triage'; demo.admin /admin/users search for 'zzzznonsense' renders 'No users match — Adjust the search or status filter'. PARTIAL: Offline shell fallback — SW is active AND controlling the page, but on the Vite-dev preview the shell HTML is served from cache while the module scripts (@vite/client, /src/main.tsx) do not hydrate offline, so the page renders as a blank body. Consistent with the review-request note that a partial result is acceptable for preview. NOT FULLY EXERCISED: buyer requirement-workspace publish-RFQ form — the buyer 'get flowers' wizard was completed successfully (Premium/Dutch Rose · 300 STEM · Bangalore, request sent), but neither /buyer/home nor /buyer/offers exposes any link to a /buyer/requests/:id detail page in this seed (only /buyer/requests/new). The RequirementDetailPage route + component exist and were statically verified in iteration_21 (no supplier-UUID input, product/variety selects, deadline input) — same live-seed limitation as before.
